claims.sentence: Fifty‐one older adults (<jats:italic>M</jats:italic><jats:sub>age</jats:sub> = 69.19, SD = 7.95) with insomnia completed 14 days of self‐reported cognition ratings (0‐very poor, 100‐very good), sleep (total sleep time (TST), sleep onset latency (SOL), wake after sleep onset (WASO), sleep efficiency), and daily cognitive tasks: Letter series (reasoning), word list delayed recall (verbal memory), Symbol Digit Modalities Test (SDMT) (attention/processing speed), and number copy (processing speed).
